title: Salt Haus 30A
meta_description: This 1BR beachside home is a few steps away from the shore. Features a modern kitchen and a bar area. Experience the best of Emerald Coast at Salt Haus 30A.
description_expanded:
Welcome to Salt Haus 30A!

Salt Haus 30A is nestled in Seagrove Beach, along County Highway 30A. Our boutique vacation rental is the perfect central resting point to experience all that 30A has to offer. Beachside and steps from the shore, our condo is also a short walk or bikeride away from nearby shops, restaurants, and experiences.

Here you can start off your morning with a cup of Nespresso, cozied up in the hanging rattan chair watching the waves, spend the day in the sun with provided \& high-end beach equipment, take a luxe shower and dry your hair with the Dyson, enjoy a sunset picnic with a glass of wine in hand, make a fresh dinner using the high end cookware, whip up a round of cocktails in the bar area, play board games on the couch, or turn on a favorite movie on the Frame TV. It's all here for you.

Fully renovated in 2022, Salt Haus is a privately-owned 1-bedroom, 1-bath, third-floor condo unit, with thoughtfully appointed details, luxury amenities, and a welcoming coastal chic aesthetic.

The loft-style bedroom features two queen beds and sits above a fully equipped kitchen and bar area, opening up to a bright living space with an inviting sofa for relaxing after those long beach days.

Filled with soft whites and creams, matte black and gold accents, light wood, breezy curtains, and lots of organic textures, every inch of the space has been meticulously designed to feel as effortless and relaxing as possible.

The living and dining areas open to large balcony with beachfront views and plenty of seating, where you can hear the crash of the waves and inhale the fresh salt air.

Additional Features \& Amenities
- Community Pool
- Community Hot Tub
- Elevator access to 3rd floor
- 2 Beach chairs
- Beach umbrella
- 2 Beach picnic baskets
- Beach tote bag
- 2 Beach mats
- Quality Cookware
- Nespresso Coffee Maker
- Standard Coffee Maker
- Beach games
- Board games
- Cookbooks \& Cocktail books
- Youtube TV \& Smart TV apps

AvantStay provides a personalized hospitality experience to elevate your stay. With our Concierge Service, guests have access to our tech-enabled services like fridge stocking, private chefs, massages, transportation, special occasion celebrations, baby gear rentals, ski gear, beach gear, and more. For anything you need, we're at your fingertips via concierge@avantstay.com.

\*Home Truths:\*
- This home allows pets for a fee. If undisclosed pets are brought into the home without AvantStay's approval there is a fine of $500 per pet.
- The bedroom is located in the loft and therefore isn't private.
- This home does not offer a washer and dryer in the unit. However, there is a laundry facility on site, which takes card.
- Please note our occupancy includes an additional two beyond bed count. Trifold floor mattresses and additional linens can be provided upon request.
- The communal pool is not heated.

Parking Details:
On-site parking is available, with parking passes provided in the unit.
No street parking is allowed. Please only use designated parking areas. Failure to comply could result in a warning or towing.

All bookings over 30 days require a security deposit to be charged after booking.

Bath: Travel-Sized Toiletries (Shower Gel, Shampoo, Conditioner, Soap)
